title: Singular affirmative yes/no questions
summary: Form olenko, oletko, and onko questions for singular persons.
objectives: Attach -ko to a singular affirmative olla form.
Place the question verb before the explicit subject.

sections.title: Attach -ko to the verb
paragraphs: A yes/no question can begin with the verb plus the question suffix -ko or -kö. These olla forms take -ko: olenko, oletko, onko.
The question form carries the same person agreement as the statement form.

sections.title: Question order
paragraphs: Put the question verb first. An explicit subject follows it: Oletko sinä kotona?
The supplied context comes last and the question ends with a question mark.

examples.english: Is he or she at work?

commonMistakes: Attach -ko to the verb, not the pronoun.
Do not keep statement word order when the question verb must lead.
Keep the person ending inside the question form.
